title: Kannada Gottu — Natural Immersion for Beginners
subtitle: Learn Kannada like a child through sound-intent association, spaced repetition, and real-world micro-challenges.

lessons.title: First Sounds & Signals
lessons.description: Master the 3 foundational sounds every baby learns first: Greetings, Agreement, and Refusal.

lessons.title: Expressing Wants & Prices
lessons.description: Express wants, refusal of offers, and ask prices while building your first two-word combinations.

lessons.title: Movement & Directions
lessons.description: Direct movement and location (Come, Go, Here, There) combined with your daily desire words.

lessons.title: Polite Stops & Small Requests
lessons.description: Ask an auto to stop, request something politely, and specify a small amount while reviewing earlier words.

lessons.title: One, Two & Enough
lessons.description: Ask for one or two items and signal when you have enough while reviewing polite requests and desire words.

lessons.title: Today, Tomorrow & Now
lessons.description: Schedule visits and express when something is needed using longer everyday phrases with now, today, and tomorrow.

lessons.title: Say It Again, Slowly
lessons.description: Ask people to repeat themselves or speak slowly, and request one more item using polite everyday sentences.

lessons.title: Ahead, Back & Nearby
lessons.description: Fine-tune directions with ahead, back, and near in polite everyday sentences for rides, deliveries, and visitors.

lessons.title: Water, Meals & Praise
lessons.description: Request water or a meal and warmly praise good food using practical everyday sentences.
